notes.title: Chapter 5 Release!
notes.notes: [p]Patch notes:[/p][list][*][p]Added Chapter 5 - the first chapter of episode 2![/p][/*][*][p]Tons of minor bugfixes/typos.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Previously" on to the beginning of Chapter 5. This can be skipped via a button up top. It may be slightly buggy as it was a literal last minute addition, but I did do as much testing as I could manage, so hopefully not![/p][/*][*][p]New minigame - only available on certain paths - disabled if minigames are turned off.[/p][/*][*][p]Updates to Statistics App. Fanlyhub didn't get an update this release, but it's possibly it may get one in a later patch.[/p][/*][*][p]4k+ New renders, 30+ Animations, 60+ New Music tracks, and tons of new story content![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Announcing the release of Chapter 5![/p][p][/p][p]As always, check the community hub or discord to report any bugs. Walkthrough is currently awaiting approval, and will hopefully be available soon - more info on that when the DLC is available - ETA unknown, but ASAP![/p]
